text_block_list.text: One day, after fighting our way through many races alongside Tamamo Cross—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Listen, there's somethin' important I gotta tell ya.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ain't it about time I earned the right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Running in races, winning, winning,
and winning some more... even this body of mine is screaming in pain.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's finally okay to use it now. That coupon!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "Why?! It's not a betting ticket! I'm not gonna kill anyone!"
Three crisp, sharp retorts landed in succession.
choice_data_list: I know, it's the Hot Spring Ticket, right?
I know, it's the Hot Spring Ticket, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Honestly... playing the fool comes so naturally to you now. Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"We're just like a comedy duo.
Alright, let's do this!"
After a witty exchange, they set off for the hot springs.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was a lovely bath~
The hot water really soaks right into these bruises~

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've got a small frame, right? All that rough
and tumble must've tired me out way more than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Having a nice, relaxing soak really saved me...
I guess I was... pushing myself too hard.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'm really sorry for everything, making you come all this way...
Tamamo Cross took time to deeply appreciate and take care of her body.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Still, I can't really settle down.
A reward is all well and good, but...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Leavin' my family behind
and comin' to a hot spring all by myself...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I told Dad, Mom, and the little ones too, ya know.
That I'd take 'em all to Arima someday.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, Arima is the name of a hot spring.
Kansai's famous 'Arima Onsen'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: At that hot spring we've all dreamed of. We used to talk about how we'd all go there together someday.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're the one who brought me
to the "Arima Kinen", right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But y'know, I still haven't kept my promise.
My promise to take everyone to Arima Onsen...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, sorry about that, getting all gloomy.
...Guess the bath water went to my head a bit.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huh? Let's go, you say...
choice_data_list: I'll invite your whole family to Arima Onsen.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wha--!? Are you sure? You've already brought me
here today, and now inviting my family too...?

"To make my family happy."
If that's what Tamamo Cross's racing is all about—
choice_data_list: The goal isn't the Arima Kinen, it's Arima Onsen.
The goal isn't the Arima Kinen, it's Arima Onsen!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ah... you...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
H-Hahaha...
You've got a way with words, don'tcha?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I can't even think of a good comeback.
You really are something else...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, the finish line is Arima Onsen...
We finally made it this far...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom.
I did it...

In this secluded, unfamiliar land,
Tamamo Cross was deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, that's enough, quit it!
This ain't like me at all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Trainer, tonight I'm gonna splash around in the hot bath and have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I've always dreamed of hot springs, too!
First off, I'm gonna soak 'til I drop!

Her worries about her family gone, Tamamo Cross
frolics playfully like an innocent child.
It was a moment where I felt an irreplaceable bond between myself and Tamamo Cross...
